_note: Descriptive reference only - no code loads this file. The engine definitions live in backend/services/evaluation_service/rubric_scorer.py (EVALUATION_ENGINES).
combined_score_rationale: Engines are reported independently and are never averaged. The previous weighted average let a fluent, well-delivered answer pass while being technically wrong, because language and delivery points offset the technical gap.

bands.75-89: Strong - correct and well reasoned, minor gaps
bands.0-39: Poor - wrong, or does not address what was asked

engines.name: Technical Correctness
engines.description: Is the answer actually right, and does it address the question asked? Scored on substance only - fluency, vocabulary, confidence and delivery are explicitly excluded and are graded by other engines.

relevance_gate.behaviour: At or above 70 relevance there is no penalty. Below it the technical score is scaled by relevance/70, so an off-topic answer cannot earn technical credit however well it is expressed.

dimensions.name: System Design Quality
dimensions.note: Only scored for system_design questions; omitted otherwise rather than defaulted.

engines.name: Language Quality
engines.description: Grammar, vocabulary, clarity and conciseness of the wording. Cannot raise or lower the technical rating.

engines.name: Speech Delivery
engines.description: Speaking pace, filler-word discipline and pause control.

engines.name: Body Language
engines.description: Eye contact, posture and gesture use on camera. Kept entirely separate from the language engine.

engines.name: Time Management
engines.description: Use of the time allotted for the question.

unassessed_policy: An engine with no input data reports assessed=false and score=null. It never substitutes a neutral mid-band score, because a fabricated 60 is indistinguishable from an earned 60 and inflates the report.
